attendance_correction_review_check.name: attendance_correction_review_check
attendance_correction_review_check.value: ("attendance_correction_requests"."status" = 'pending' AND "attendance_correction_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "attendance_correction_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) OR ("attendance_correction_requests"."status" IN ('approved','rejected') AND "attendance_correction_requests"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_correction_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

attendance_correction_rejection_check.name: attendance_correction_rejection_check
attendance_correction_rejection_check.value: "attendance_correction_requests"."status" != 'rejected' OR ("attendance_correction_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("attendance_correction_requests"."rejection_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)
